item.title: Milestones - Take the Win While You Can - Opinion
item.description: As Publisher Miles Barber points out, events are now happening in Santa Clara because the mayor is playing games.

item.title: Santa Clara has a Transparency Problem — Still
item.description: Santa Clara continues to have an unaddressed problem with transparency and at least one council member is now speaking out.

item.title: This Weekend in the Valley: Friday, March 20 – Sunday, March 22
item.description: This Weekend in the Valley, Roberta Jones Junior Theatre presents Matilda the Musical. Also, there's San Jose Sharks Barbie Game Day.

item.title: Fremont Softball’s Impressive 2029 Class Led by Star Senior
item.description: Mentored by senior Jiyah Caban, the Fremont Firebirds have a mix of young talent learning to win this season.

item.title: Santa Clara Basketball Players Ready to Represent School, Community
item.description: The SCU men's basketball team knows when it steps on the court on Friday it will represent the school and the community.

item.title: MacDonald Coaching Staff Leads North to Victory in 51st Annual Wedemeyer All-Star Game
item.description: The MacDonald football coaching staff guided the North Team to victory at the annual Wedemeyer All-Star game.

item.title: Gaps in Council Procedure Spark Heated Debate
item.description: The Santa Clara City Council bent the rules of its own parliamentary process to bring back an old item that had previously failed a vote.

item.title: VTA Details Super Bowl Ridership Lessons
item.description: Using Super Bowl LX as a test run, VTA believes it is ready for the influx of passengers attending the FIFA World Cup Games this summer.

item.title: Santa Clara County, Eight Others Win Settlement Against Walgreens Drugstores
item.description: The District Attorneys of 9 California counties announced a more then $6M lawsuit settlement with Walgreens for selling expired products.

item.title: Hardy Kim and Annanda Barclay, Won’t You Be My Neighbor?
item.description: Pastors Hardy Kim and Annanda Barclay spent Super Bowl Sunday at Redwood Square Park in Sunnyvale, meeting community members.

item.title: Bruins Softball Eager for Home Rematch Against Vikings
item.description: Santa Clara softball lost 10-0 to Palo Alto on March 31, but the players believe a healthier team will help even the score in a rematch.

item.title: This Weekend in the Valley: Friday, April 3 – Sunday, April 5
item.description: This Weekend in the Valley there's an Easter event at Cityline, Sunnyvale. The San Jose Sharks are having a Marvel Super Hero Night too.

item.title: Thousands Line El Camino for 3rd No Kings Protest
item.description: Thousands of people lined El Camino Real on March 28 for a third No Kings Day protest against President Trump's policies.

item.title: Planning Commission Discusses Charter Changes
item.description: At its March 11 meeting, the Santa Clara Planning Commission discussed the changes it would like to see to its section in the City Charter.

item.title: Novel “Into the Moonbroch” Rings True with Santa Clara Valley’s Portuguese
item.description: Author Debra Gomes Korbel talks about her debut novel "Into the Moonbroch" and its connection to her family's history.
